Name: Remove redundant columns in related tables
Description: A non-key column that is duplicated across two related tables wastes memory; keep it on one side and let the relationship propagate it. Needs data profiling to confirm — reported as Not Evaluated by the metadata-only engine.

Name: Do not use floating point data types
Description: Double (floating point) columns are imprecise and compress poorly. Use Decimal / Fixed Decimal instead.

Name: Set IsAvailableInMdx to false on non-attribute columns
Description: Hidden columns not used as attributes (e.g. measure-support or fact columns) can have IsAvailableInMdx=false to save memory and speed processing.

Name: Avoid bi-directional relationships against high-cardinality columns
Description: Bi-directional cross-filtering over a high-cardinality key forces expensive scans. (Cardinality not measured from metadata; all bi-directional relationships are listed for review.)

Name: Reduce usage of calculated columns that use RELATED
Description: Calculated columns using RELATED() are often better done in Power Query or as measures; they bloat the model and slow refresh.

Name: Consider a star schema instead of a snowflake
Description: Snowflake chains (dimension related to another dimension) hurt performance and usability. Flattening dimension tables into a star schema is recommended.

Name: Unpivot pivoted (month) data
Description: Tables with month-named columns (Jan, Feb, …) are pivoted; unpivot them into attribute+value rows for proper time analysis.

Name: Split date and time
Description: DateTime columns are high-cardinality; split into a Date column and a Time column (unless the table is marked as a Date table).

Name: Model should have a date table
Description: A dedicated date/calendar table is required for reliable time-intelligence DAX.

Name: Date/calendar tables should be marked as a date table
Description: A calendar table that is not marked as a Date table (DataCategory=Time) breaks time intelligence.

Name: Remove auto-date table
Description: Power BI's automatic date/time creates hidden per-column date tables that bloat the model. Disable it and use a shared date table.

Name: Limit row-level security (RLS) logic
Description: Complex RLS filter expressions slow every query. (Requires the roles DMV — Not Evaluated by the current extractor.)

Name: Avoid excessive bi-directional or many-to-many relationships
Description: Too many bi-directional or many-to-many relationships cause ambiguous filter propagation and slow queries.

Name: Minimize Power Query transformations
Description: Very long M scripts (many applied steps) should be pushed upstream to the source where possible.

Name: Many-to-many relationships should be single-direction
Description: Many-to-many relationships with bi-directional filtering create ambiguous paths; make them single-direction.

Name: Reduce usage of calculated tables
Description: Calculated tables are memory-resident and recomputed on refresh; prefer Power Query / source tables where possible.

Name: Time-intelligence measures with DirectQuery
Description: Time-intelligence functions behave differently (and often slower / unsupported) under DirectQuery. Flagged only when the model uses DirectQuery.

Name: Avoid many-to-many relationships on tables used for dynamic RLS
Description: Many-to-many relationships on RLS tables can leak or hide data. (Requires the roles DMV — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Large tables should be partitioned
Description: Large fact tables should use partitions / incremental refresh. (Row counts not available from metadata — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Check if bi-directional and many-to-many relationships are valid
Description: Review each bi-directional / many-to-many relationship to confirm it is intentional and correct.

Name: No two measures should have the same definition
Description: Two measures with identical DAX are redundant; consolidate to one.

Name: No two calculated columns should have the same definition
Description: Two calculated columns with identical DAX are redundant; consolidate.

Name: Column references should be fully qualified
Description: Use Table[Column] for column references (heuristic parse).

Name: Use TREATAS instead of INTERSECT for virtual relationships
Description: TREATAS is more efficient than INTERSECT for virtual relationships.

Name: Use the DIVIDE function for division
Description: Use DIVIDE() to handle divide-by-zero safely instead of the / operator with a non-constant denominator.

Name: Avoid using the IFERROR function
Description: IFERROR hides real errors and hurts performance; prevent the error condition instead (e.g. DIVIDE).

Name: Measures should not be direct references of other measures
Description: A measure whose definition is just [OtherMeasure] is an unnecessary wrapper.

Name: Filter column values with proper syntax
Description: Prefer CALCULATE boolean column filters over wrapping whole tables in FILTER. (Deep DAX parse — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Filter measure values by columns, not tables
Description: Filter by specific columns rather than entire tables for performance. (Deep DAX parse — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Inactive relationships that are never activated
Description: An inactive relationship never activated by USERELATIONSHIP() is dead weight; remove it or use it.

Name: Avoid using '1-(x/y)' syntax
Description: Rewrite 1-(x/y) using DIVIDE for clarity and safe division.

Name: EVALUATEANDLOG should not be used in production
Description: EVALUATEANDLOG is a debugging function and must be removed from production models.

Name: Data columns must have a source column
Description: An imported (data) column with no SourceColumn is orphaned and will error on refresh.

Name: Expression-reliant objects must have an expression
Description: Measures and calculated columns with an empty expression are broken.

Name: Avoid USERELATIONSHIP and RLS against the same table
Description: USERELATIONSHIP combined with RLS on the same table can produce incorrect security filtering. (Requires roles DMV — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Relationship columns should be of the same data type
Description: The two columns in a relationship should share a data type; mismatches cause coercion errors / bad joins.

Name: Avoid invalid characters in names
Description: Object names with control / problematic characters can break DAX and downstream tools.

Name: Avoid invalid characters in descriptions
Description: Descriptions with control characters can corrupt metadata exchange.

Name: Set IsAvailableInMdx to true on necessary columns
Description: Columns used as Sort-By (or otherwise needed by clients/Excel) must have IsAvailableInMdx=true or queries fail.

Name: Avoid structured data sources with provider partitions
Description: Mixing structured data sources with legacy provider partitions causes refresh failures. (Requires data-source DMV — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Remove unnecessary columns
Description: Hidden columns not referenced by relationships, sort-by, hierarchies or DAX are candidates for removal. (Report-visual usage not considered here.)

Name: Remove unnecessary measures
Description: Hidden measures not referenced by any other measure are candidates for removal. (Report-visual usage not considered here.)

Name: Remove data sources not referenced by any partitions
Description: Orphaned data sources should be removed. (Requires data-source DMV — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Ensure tables have relationships
Description: A table with no relationships is usually disconnected by mistake (date tables / disconnected parameter tables excepted).

Name: One-to-one relationships should be avoided
Description: One-to-one relationships usually mean the two tables should be merged into one.

Name: Visible objects with no description
Description: Visible tables, columns and measures should have descriptions for discoverability and AI/Q&A.

Name: Calculation groups with no calculation items
Description: An empty calculation group does nothing and should be removed. (Requires calculation-items DMV — Not Evaluated.)

Name: Object names must not contain special characters
Description: Avoid special characters in object names for clean, portable naming.

Name: Trim object names
Description: Leading/trailing whitespace in names causes confusion and lookup errors.

Name: First letter of objects must be capitalized
Description: Visible object names should start with an uppercase letter.

Name: Provide format string for measures
Description: Visible numeric measures should have an explicit format string.

Name: Provide format string for Date columns
Description: Date/DateTime columns should have a format string (default dd-MM-yyyy).

Name: Do not summarize numeric columns
Description: Visible numeric columns should have SummarizeBy=None to prevent accidental implicit measures.

Name: Add data category for columns
Description: Geographic / URL / image columns should have a Data Category set for correct visuals and Q&A.

Name: Percentages should use thousands separators and 1 decimal
Description: Percentage measures should use a consistent format such as #,##0.0%.

Name: Whole numbers should use thousands separators and no decimals
Description: Integer measures should use a thousands-separated format such as #,##0.

Name: Relationship columns should be of integer data type
Description: Relationship keys should be whole numbers for best scan performance.

Name: Hide foreign keys
Description: Foreign-key columns (many-side of a relationship) should be hidden from report authors.

Name: Mark primary keys
Description: The one-side key column of a relationship should be marked as a key (IsKey=true).

Name: Reduce the total number of pages (> threshold)
Description: Reports with more than ~10 pages are hard to navigate. (Report-layer rule — run against the .pbix report.)

Name: Reduce number of bookmarks per report (> threshold)
Description: Too many bookmarks (default >10) complicate navigation. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Reduce visuals per page (> threshold)
Description: Pages with more than ~50 visuals load slowly. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Reduce usage of TOPN filters (> threshold)
Description: Many TOPN filters per page are expensive (default >4). (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Reduce usage of advanced filters (> threshold)
Description: Many advanced filters per page add complexity (default >4). (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Hide tooltip/drillthrough pages
Description: Tooltip and drillthrough pages should be hidden from end users. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Avoid vertical scrolling (page too tall)
Description: Pages taller than the canvas (default >720px) force scrolling. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Remove unused custom visuals
Description: Imported custom visuals not used on any page bloat the report. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Reduce the number of objects within visuals (> threshold)
Description: Visuals with too many fields/series (default >8) are slow and hard to read. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Avoid enabling 'Show items with no data'
Description: 'Show items with no data' forces expensive cross-joins. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Use theme colors rather than custom HEX values
Description: Hard-coded HEX colors break theme consistency. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Provide alt text to improve accessibility
Description: Visuals should have alt text for accessibility. (Report-layer rule; disabled by default in MeasureKiller.)

Name: Use caution with pie/donut charts
Description: Pie/donut charts are hard to read with many categories. (Report-layer rule.)

Name: Avoid using implicit measures
Description: Visuals should use explicit measures, not implicit aggregations of columns. (Report-layer rule.)
